description: Free: mint a signed single-use PUT URL for a long file (up to 100 MB / 180 min; MP3/WAV are segmented). PUT via plain HTTP; the PUT response carries the exact price. Then speech_job_submit with uploadId.

bytes.description: Optional file size hint in bytes.

contentType.description: Content-Type to use on PUT (audio/* or video/*).

durationSeconds.description: Declared duration hint (can only raise the price).

summary.description: Include a short summary when done.

webhook.description: Optional public https URL for a signed job.done callback.

name: speech_job_upload_url
title: Free upload URL for a long-file job
